text:
Blockchain technology works like a shared digital record book that is distributed across many computers rather than stored in one central location. This setup makes it very secure and transparent. Each page, or "block," holds a group of transactions. Once these transactions are checked and added to the book, they cannot be changed or erased. This is because each new page is securely locked to the previous one using complex math codes. This chain of connections makes it nearly impossible for anyone to cheat or tamper with the records.
